01What makes Vivasoft one of the best software development companies in Bangladesh?

Vivasoft stands out for its proven experience in delivering scalable, secure, and high-performing custom software for global clients.
Our in-house team of 300+ engineers follows an agile development approach, from product discovery and UX design to deployment and ongoing support – ensuring every project meets business goals and technical excellence.

02How much does custom software development cost in Bangladesh?

The cost of custom software development in Bangladesh typically ranges from $5,000 to $50,000+, depending on complexity, features, and technology stack.
At Vivasoft, we offer flexible engagement models, fixed-price, hourly, or dedicated teams — to fit both startups and enterprises while maintaining world-class quality at competitive offshore rates.

03Why should I outsource software development to Bangladesh?

Outsourcing to Bangladesh gives you access to a highly skilled talent pool, competitive pricing, and reliable communication.
Vivasoft, as one of the country’s top offshore software companies, has delivered successful projects across the US, Australia, and Europe, combining technical depth with cultural alignment and English-proficient teams.

04What technologies does Vivasoft use for software development?

Our developers specialize in modern stacks like .NET, Node.js, React, Angular, Next.js, Flutter, Kotlin, AWS, and Azure.
We choose the right technology based on each project’s scalability, performance, and business requirements to build future-ready digital solutions.
